blocks.text: Luxury kitchens
A kitchen designed around you

Dreaming of a luxurious kitchen? Yello Pro serves Laval, Montréal and the North Shore with a turnkey service that covers your project from start to finish. We also work with architects and architectural technologists to prepare custom plans.
We take the time to understand your ideas, preferences and everyday needs. Ask for a free estimate for a kitchen that reflects your style.
The details that make your kitchen work

Careful planning starts with your habits, your tastes and the space available. A waterfall countertop can add a distinctive edge to an island, while an integrated range hood changes the overall look. A walk-in pantry improves storage and access; a wine cellar or wine storage area adds a decorative feature.

Cabinet and drawer organizers make a difference every day, even when they are out of sight. Consider the hardware, countertop and cabinet materials, and the performance of your appliances alongside the overall design.
Countertop materials
Countertops strongly influence the finished appearance of a kitchen. Compare the look, maintenance and limitations of each material before choosing.
Marble
An elegant, timeless natural stone. Sealing and appropriate care help preserve its appearance. Confirm the maintenance requirements of the particular product you choose.
Granite
Each slab has its own pattern. Granite is valued for durability and heat resistance. Follow the supplier’s sealing and care instructions for the selected stone.
Vetrazzo
Made with recycled glass, Vetrazzo adds distinctive colour and texture. Ask the supplier about the sealing and maintenance requirements of your selected finish.
Quartz
Quartz offers a stone-like look and is easy to maintain. It is resistant to everyday staining and scratching, but hot cookware can damage or discolour it: use suitable protection.
